findings.comment: Approval block shows 'UNDER SECTION 112 OF CHAPTER 25-5' language but both authorization checkboxes (ADMINISTRATIVELY / BY COMMISSION) are left blank. The applicant must clearly indicate whether the project qualifies for administrative (Director) approval per § 25-5-112 or requires Land Use Commission approval per § 25-5-142, and the correct checkbox must be marked.

The approval block does not include a field or designation for 'DDZ' (Desired Development Zone). The project is located in the West Bouldin Creek Watershed (Urban classification), which places it within the Desired Development Zone. The approval block must include a DDZ designation field with 'DDZ' marked or stated.

applicableAreas: All non-cover plan sheets (plat, general notes, site plan, grading, drainage, utility, landscaping, construction details, wall details)
findings.comment: Non-cover sheets (Sheets 2, 3, 9, 11, 15 examined) do not reserve blank space in the lower right corner for batch stamping. All examined sheets have the lower right corner fully occupied by the professional engineer's seal, project information blocks, and design credentials. A minimum 3.5 inches × 5 inches blank rectangular space must be reserved in the lower right corner of each non-cover sheet for City batch stamping; a 1 inch × 1 inch alternative is acceptable. This requirement applies to all 38 non-cover sheets.

The site plan approval block contains the text 'RELEASED FOR GENERAL COMPLIANCE' which must be removed. This language is not part of the formal approval block structure and must be deleted from the plans before resubmittal.

The approval block lists 'Jim Gobel' as the case manager. The applicant's submittal does not contain sufficient documentation to verify whether this individual is the currently assigned case manager for case SP-2025-0126C. Confirmation of current case manager assignment must be obtained through DSD records.
